supporting_evidence: Triton tl.dot -> tcgen05.mma on B300 sm_103a (501.28 TFLOPS, 68.54 us, sample1 +1.38%, 66,048 full spans)
tcgen05.guidance: Use tcgen05 when the compiled/measured artifact demonstrates it. Keep K-loop inline-PTX calls behind a runtime SSA predicate (_fi_rt_gate) so Blackwell multi-stage tcgen05 pipelining succeeds.

wgmma.guidance: No B300 wgmma evidence is present in the owned cards. H20 wgmma evidence does not transfer. Probe sm_100a and sm_103a independently before labeling a B300 artifact as wgmma.

recorder.open_close: FI_OPEN installs the lane/wave/CTA recorder predicate; FI_CLOSE is required on every executed exit path and hoists atom.global.or.b32 overflow reporting.
fits: ABI tag fields must match the selected recorder. Do not invent a new event layout in the recipe.
notes: Use one logical begin/end pair per selected semantic interval.

Pillar I-IV (v14 <= 10% perturbation engine): Predicated inline PTX @p_rec/@p_store single-16B st.global.cs.v4.u32 in fi_triton.py supports FI_TIMER=1 dual-anchor affine %clock64 calibration, hoisted atom.global.or.b32 overflow reporting in fi_close, and closed-loop stride selection S in {full(1), stride4(4), stride8(8)} guaranteeing Measured_Overhead(S*) <= 10.0% (fi_trace_gate.py G1-G5).
Compute CTA-local warp IDs via 'shr.u32 warp, tid, 5;' rather than physical %warpid (0..63) so multi-CTA residency never drops CTAs.
Keep aux stable between pair members so waits and phases can be correlated.
The device recorder can only carry a 32-bit aux; move larger descriptors to names.json or the capture metadata.

source_recognition_policy.resolution: Assign a semantic ID only after reading the enclosing dataflow and the operator/task boundary.

correctness_hazards: SASS/ISA disturbance: instrumentation and surrounding code motion can change instruction count, register allocation, spills, vector width, and the selected tensor-core or copy family. Compile FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 and compare the final SASS.
Divergence/mask: a recorder in a divergent branch can produce unpaired records or deadlock a barrier. Preserve the original predicate and use the target wave size for lane selection.
Buffer overflow: fixed slots can fill or point out of range. Require the device overflow bits to be zero, records per lane to stay below cap, and no ring/wrap behavior.

Asynchronous completion: cp.async, TMA, tcgen05, and collectives have issue and completion boundaries that are not interchangeable. wgmma remains unverified for B300 and must not be inferred from H20.
Correctness drift: moving code across predicates, fences, or waits can change numerical results or visibility even when the kernel still runs.
validation_requirements: Parse all JSON and validate this document against knowledge/validation/schemas/recipe.schema.json.
Use only semantic IDs present in knowledge/semantic_ids.json; display names must exactly equal their IDs.
Compile off, entry-only, and full builds with Python 3.10 orchestration where applicable; compare final SASS and register/spill metrics.
Run full-output correctness against an uninstrumented reference with tail, mask, dtype, and shape cases for the selected operator.
Verify cap, slot count, records per lane, overflow bits, and trace completeness.
Capture the selected hardware evidence with the card profiler and keep B300 sm_100a/sm_103a evidence separate.

recorder.guard: n = fi_open(rec_ptr, ovf_ptr, pid, FI, role); /* ... */ n = fi_close(rec_ptr, ovf_ptr, pid, n, FI)
notes: Import the NVIDIA frontend from 2_instrument/recorders/triton/fi_triton.py.
EV_SOFTMAX must be a tl.constexpr from the canonical event constants; keep and return the loop-carried n.

parameterization.aux: packed uint32 tile id, row id, or work id; the matching begin/end/mark records must reuse the same value
parameterization.tile: linear_tile = tile_m * num_n_tiles + tile_n; keep row and tile dimensions in metadata when needed for attribution
parameterization.work_id: for persistent/megakernel paths use the claimed work id; do not substitute the CTA id
parameterization.note: Canonical event_id and event_id_const come only from knowledge/semantic_ids.json; 0 is the empty record sentinel.

correctness_hazards: Do not change score scaling, masking, running-max order, or denominator handling when adding begin/end anchors; softmax can overflow or change numerics under semantically equivalent rewrites.
Keep begin and end in matching convergent control flow and preserve the original mask so inactive rows do not emit paired records from divergent paths.
Every event consumes a fixed slot; budget softmax subtask anchors, check cap and n_slots, and require both overflow bits to remain zero.
Validate logits-to-probability tolerance and downstream attention output against an uninstrumented reference; do not infer a compiler-generated softmax opcode from the semantic label.
validation: Compare row maxima, denominators, probabilities, and the final operator output against an uninstrumented reference with the original dtype and mask behavior.
Verify one paired begin/end per selected softmax interval, canonical tag EV_SOFTMAX, matching aux values, and no missing or truncated records.
Confirm the capture keeps wait time separate from softmax compute and that asynchronous score loads are complete before the softmax interval begins.
Record assembly_change_rate and reject the instrumented build if softmax numerics or the surrounding attention/operator output exceeds the project tolerance.

evidence.basis: Per-architecture evidence is recorded in architecture_variants. The top-level status summarizes the variant records and must not be cited as a merged sm_100a/sm_103a claim.
notes: Absence of a recipe-specific softmax probe is not evidence that a compiler emits a particular form. Keep the semantic unverified until exact-architecture compiled or measured evidence is recorded.
architecture_variants are exact architecture evidence records; top-level machine_profiles is the exact-profile index and is not a merged architecture claim.
